title: Customer Service Desk Card: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Courtesy Waiver Allowances
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A courtesy waiver on the on-time-history basis is measured against two tier figures: the number of courtesy late-charge waivers allowed in any 12 calendar months, and the number of installments in a row without a late charge that the contract must show.

| Tier | Courtesy waivers allowed in any 12 calendar months | Installments in a row without a late charge required |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 0 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 0 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 1 | 9 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 1 | 6 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 1 | 6 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 2 | 6 |

## Desk notes on the card

- An allowance of 0 means the tier receives no courtesy waivers at all, whatever its run of on-time installments: Tier 5 and Tier 4 receive none.
- The run requirement is a minimum: a Tier 3 contract showing exactly 9 installments in a row without a late charge meets it; one showing 8 does not.
- The allowance is a count that must not yet be used up: a Tier 1+ contract that has received 1 courtesy waiver in the last 12 calendar months is below its allowance of 2; one that has received 2 is not.
